profile: Mirum Pharmaceuticals develops and commercializes medicines for rare diseases. Its commercial portfolio includes Livmarli for Alagille syndrome and progressive familial intrahepatic cholestasis; ATEBRIOZ for fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva; and Cholbam and Ctexli for specified bile-acid disorders. Its pipeline includes volixibat for cholestatic liver diseases, brelovitug for chronic hepatitis delta, and MRM-3379 for fragile X syndrome.
